files.evidence/session-notes.md:
Extracted from the period's transcripts by the review script. User messages in the period contain no corrections or complaints.

- s-604, s-611, s-619: before running integration tests the agent first tried port 5432, got "connection refused", then read docker-compose.yml and found the test database on port 55432. No memory entry or instruction records the port.
- s-606, s-615, s-624: the agent wrote the release notes section by hand: listed merged commits with `git log`, grouped them by type and copied the version header from the previous section. Each took 15-20 tool calls.
- s-609, s-617, s-620, s-623: file-lookup subagents ("find where X is defined") were launched with the largest model at maximum effort; 11 such launches, median 4 minutes each, each returned a file path and a few lines.

files.evidence/settings-suggestion.md:
Note left by the agent at the end of session s-719 (2026-10-23):

Worker subagents in s-707, s-712 and s-719 used a 1-hour prompt-cache lifetime instead of the default 5 minutes. Each of these sessions cost less than a comparable task before the change (s-688, s-695, s-701). Suggest making the 1-hour cache lifetime the default for all worker subagents.
files.evidence/usage.md:
Usage records exist for 46 sessions in the period (cost, cache reads, cache writes, worker count and cache lifetime per session). Only the sessions named in the note were exported for this review.

| Session | Task | Workers | Cache lifetime | Cost (units) | Cache read share |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| s-688 | refactor parser | 6 | 5 min | 41 | 52% |
| s-695 | add export command | 4 | 5 min | 30 | 57% |
| s-701 | fix date handling | 2 | 5 min | 12 | 49% |
| s-707 | refactor lexer | 3 | 1 hour | 25 | 81% |
| s-712 | add import command | 4 | 1 hour | 27 | 78% |
| s-719 | fix time zones | 2 | 1 hour | 11 | 84% |

The 1-hour lifetime bills cache writes at a higher rate than the 5-minute lifetime.
